overview.title: POWER FOUR + NOTRE DAME  |  2027–2031  |  MODEL v2.0
overview.subtitle: Five-year scheduling counterfactual • scenario, not official NCAA or conference schedules
notes: 02 Weekly Games: 2,210 unique games with week, date, site and source URL.
03 Team Calendar: 340 team/season rows; 14 week-by-week slots including 2 byes.
04 Team Games: 4,080 team-centric game rows suitable for filtering and pivoting.
05 Conference H-A: every conference pairing gets an administrative home and away visit within five years.
06 Annual Validation: every P4 and Notre Dame team passes 12 games, 11 Power, 1 G6 and conference quota.
07 Rivalry Locks: every protected annual rivalry is preserved; USC–Notre Dame follows published hiatus.
08 P4 Balance and 09 Team Crossplay: audit distribution across conference combinations.
10 P4 Repeat Audit: lists recurring interleague opponents; annual locked rivalries exempt from minimization.
11 G6 Assignments: 340 G6 games; all P4 G6 visitors play on P4 campus, except ND–Navy.
12 Conference Sources: completeness of verified future published home/away commitments.
13 Contract Exceptions: specific known incompatibilities and modeling decisions.
14 Sources: official source ledger; link for each published fixture also on game row.
IMPORTANT: "Published" describes fixtures verified in selected sources, not a full audit of every future contract.
IMPORTANT: 2027 Florida–Georgia is Tampa under official contract; Jacksonville from 2028. Neutral admin home ≠ campus visit.
IMPORTANT: G6 games ALWAYS hosted on P4 campuses, except annual Notre Dame–Navy; seven published conflicting venues overridden.
IMPORTANT: Week dates of unpinned fixtures are hypothetical; no TV slots or opponent-specific G6 full seasons modeled.

MODEL v2.0 (2026-10-15): Byes: each team's two byes are separated by at least 4 games (no back-to-back byes). No P4 non-conference opponent in consecutive seasons, except the six protected rivalries and published multi-year series. Clemson–Notre Dame treated as annual: 2030 game added (Clemson at Notre Dame). All published games kept; only model-generated non-conference games were re-paired.
16 Version History: changes from the previous model version.

assumptions.explanation: 2027–2031; 14 weekly Saturday slots incl. Week 0 and two team byes. Default week dates are Saturdays, not published kickoff times.
67 current Power 4 conference football members + Notre Dame = 68
9 for SEC, Big Ten, Big 12; ACC 16 x9 and 1 x8 per year; Notre Dame 0 conference league games
2027 Clemson per official release; 2028 Stanford, 2029 SMU, 2030 California, 2031 Boston College assumed rotating exceptions
At least five ACC matchups annually under existing football arrangement.
P4 means SEC, Big Ten, Big 12, ACC and Notre Dame independent. Pac-12 counted as G6, despite own FBS conference.
Forbidden; no FCS opponent in generated set.
Conference named protections and six annually recurring cross-league rivalries locked. USC–ND hiatus followed until 2030.
Each intra-league pair appears at least once with Team A administratively home and once with Team B administratively home over 5 seasons.
Florida–Georgia and Oklahoma–Texas administratively home/away; actually held at designated neutral stadium, not a campus.
Published Tampa site preserved, although user preference was Jacksonville; Jacksonville resumes 2028.
Only verified fixtures and selected stadiums entered as hard constraints; gaps are model-generated, not official schedules.
SciPy MILP hard coverage and mandates; annual P4 cross-conference matching minimizes repeat opponents and directional skew.
14-color multigraph week assignment with published weeks and rivalry-week pins when feasible; Kempe swaps avoid team double bookings.
One G6 each team each year; prioritizes same state/region; minimizes G6 opponent repeats and same-week double booking.

EVERY SEC, Big Ten, Big 12, and ACC game versus a G6 opponent is played at the P4 school home campus. No P4 at G6 road games and no neutral G6 venues. Notre Dame–Navy alone may alternate home/away per its rivalry arrangement. Previously published conflicting locations are explicitly overridden.
Conference home count 4–5 for nine-game team, 3–5 for eight-game ACC exception. P4 nonconf home determined by overall target.
G6 complete schedules not generated; avoid simultaneous duplicate opponent usage on modeled game dates only.
Python random seed = 20271014; deterministic solver inputs with fixed published fixtures.
Published pinned dates enforced where entered; other schedules represent plausible hypothetical Saturday placements.
No assertion of exhaustively reading all 68 athletic department 2027–31 future schedule databases; verify further before operational use.
Model is a structural scenario and conflict audit; not a mutually ratified future contract calendar.
